draft.title: Vision and kidney technologies
card: Many vision problems happen because the cornea or lens does not focus light exactly on the retina. Glasses and contact lenses add a lens in front of the eye to bend the light so the image focuses on the retina.
Laser surgery reshapes the cornea. The reshaped cornea bends light correctly, so the person may no longer need glasses or contact lenses.
The kidneys filter waste and extra water from the blood. In kidney failure they can no longer do this well enough, and wastes build up in the body.
Dialysis is a technology that filters the blood using a machine or a fluid placed in the abdomen. It does the filtering job of the failed kidneys, but it does not repair them.
draft.remember: Vision technologies correct how light is focused. Dialysis replaces the kidneys' filtering of blood.

a.q: Which statement best describes how laser surgery corrects vision?
opts: It reshapes the cornea so light focuses on the retina
It adds a lens in front of the eye to bend light
It sends electrical signals to the optic nerve
It filters wastes out of the blood
a.why: Laser surgery changes the shape of the cornea, so light is bent correctly and focuses on the retina. Glasses and contact lenses also correct focus, but they add a lens and do not reshape the cornea.
a.clue: Think about which part of the eye the laser changes.

b.q: Sam's kidneys have failed, and he now has dialysis three times a week. What does the dialysis do for him?
opts: It filters wastes from his blood in place of his kidneys
It repairs the damaged tissue so his kidneys work again
It makes his kidneys produce more urine
It adds a lens so light focuses on his retina
b.why: Dialysis does the filtering job of the failed kidneys, so wastes do not build up in the blood. It does not repair the kidneys, which is why it is the tempting wrong answer: it treats the effect of failure but does not restore the organ.
b.clue: Dialysis takes over a job. Does it fix the organ?

a.best: It reshapes the cornea so light focuses on the retina

b.best: It filters wastes from his blood in place of his kidneys
